posts.text:
A non-toxic workplace isn't a workplace where everyone is best friends. It's a workplace:
Where you don't have to be scared of being honest.
Where saying "I don't understand" doesn't make you look incompetent.
Where taking a sick day doesn't make you feel guilty.
Where your manager can give you feedback without humiliating you.
Where you can disagree with the founder without worrying that you've just ruined your career.
Where people are appreciated when things are going well, but also supported when they're not.
And honestly, I think this is something startups especially need to understand. You don't build a strong team by making people afraid of you. You build one by making people feel safe enough to contribute. Because when people stop worrying about surviving the workplace, they finally have the energy to actually improve it. 🤍
#WorkplaceCulture #ToxicWorkCulture #Leadership #StartupCulture #EmployeeExperience #WorkLife

There’s something nobody tells you about growing professionally:
You will outgrow versions of yourself you once thought were permanent.

The way you work.
The things you tolerate.
The people you try to impress.
The goals you once believed were everything.

And honestly, that can feel uncomfortable. Because growth isn't always getting more. Sometimes it's realizing you don't want the same things anymore. So if you're in a phase where everything feels a little uncertain

DONT PANIC!!!

Maybe you're not lost.
Maybe you're just becoming someone new🌱
#CareerGrowth #PersonalGrowth #Mindset #LinkedIn #Growth

Personal branding can happen anywhere. Even on a  wish card. 😂


Left this at Krunch cheese today with my little wish:

“I wanna be the top breakfast for Karachi’s top food brands.”

And yes, I put my @ there on purpose. 👀


You miss 100% of the opportunities you don't make yourself visible for, right? 😂

Now, Karachi food brands… I’ve left the invitation.
If you feel your workplace doesn't value you, leave. Don't spend a second where your worth is constantly overlooked.

sections.title: What I offer
sections.body:
I create authentic B2B content that helps brands connect with founders, professionals, and decision-makers.

• LinkedIn posts & thought leadership
• Product reviews & software demos
• AI & SaaS tool features
• Marketing and business strategy content
• Brand storytelling & founder-focused campaigns
• UGC-style videos and short-form content
• Product launches & campaign collaborations
• Event coverage and brand partnerships

I love working with SaaS, AI, technology, startups, productivity, education, fintech, and B2B brands. Every collaboration is tailored to match your brand voice while delivering content that informs, engages, and builds trust.

sections.title: Time from booking to post
sections.body: Typical turnaround: 1 to 3 business days. For urgent campaigns, I offer faster delivery whenever possible. I prioritize quality, clear communication, and content that aligns with your brand's objectives

sections.title: How I work
sections.body: I start by understanding your campaign goals, then create authentic, audience-first content that aligns with your brand. Drafts are shared for approval when required, revisions are welcome, and I ensure clear communication and on-time delivery throughout the collaboration.
